commit.subject: refactor(steme): split audit capability into preflight and execute
commit.body:
Split core/modules/audit/capability.ts's computeAudit into two composable
methods: preflight (app path + rulepack + config + skill/concept reference
validation, no app source read) returning a validated AuditPreflight, and
execute (import-graph build + rule evaluation) consuming it. computeAudit stays
as a thin preflight→execute wrapper so every call site and all output is
byte-identical. New fake-port unit tests prove preflight performs no execution.
This isolates the seam the ordered-preflight reorder builds on next.

commit.subject: feat(steme): validate all inputs in an ordered preflight before audit execution
commit.body:
Add an audit-target existence precheck as preflight's first step and reorder
both CLI callers so the baseline register is validated and the missing-baseline
refusals (--fail-on-new, accept-drift) fire before execute() builds the import
graph. Establishes the spec's ordered preflight — target → config → rulepack →
baseline → refusals → execution — with first-failing-step precedence, restoring
fail-fast for the guaranteed-refusal cases and defining which error wins when
multiple inputs are bad. computeAudit is removed in favour of preflight/execute.
Every single-bad-input scenario stays byte-identical; new E2E scenarios cover
the multi-input ordering deltas.

phases.title: Ordered preflight: target precheck and baseline before execution
